comment: The assets RPCS3 ships, each with its origin and licence (ps5/tools/build-assets.py). Add each new one here, with its licence: only assets with a clear licence are shipped.

sources.download: files fetched at pinned SHA-256 hashes into build/ps5/downloads/: the asset pack's (SaschaWillems/Vulkan-Assets at a27c0e584434) whose licences are clear
sources.generated: ps5/tools/generate_assets.py: geometry and noise written there, or CC0 files it downloads (Poly Haven; Khronos's glTF-Sample-Assets at f36bfdabd1031c3cf6689a50570b8cdf3678b49c) at pinned SHA-256 hashes
sources.file: a file kept in this repository (ps5/assets/)

assets.title: Lantern (glTF sample model)
